g.text: VISUAL LAB / ROUND 21 / INTEGER-HARMONIC QUANTIZATION · ZERO SEAM POP · NO VIDEO DIFFUSION CLAIM
Quantize frequencies to integer cycles; close the loop seam. / 量化整倍谐波，消除循环接缝跳帧。
56 solids · 13/13 checks · quantized seam gap 0.000000 u vs unquantized pop 1.8875 u
8192 CPU 16-rib wave frames: factored basis 19.16 ms / direct Math.sin 68.78 ms
将各分量角频率量化为 ω_m = 2π·n_m/T (n=1,2,4,5)，消除 t=T→0 处 1.8875 u 位置跳变与 4.527 u/s 速度跳变。
